english.title: Learner driver drive a vehicle while on motorway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), when authorised to drive that vehicle only by virtue of being the holder of a provisional licence
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11 of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
